params.name: Top bar button
params.tooltip:
How the Supply Gaps button in the top-left bar looks.
Text: the word "Gaps" without a frame. Icon: a house icon
on a dark tile, like the game's data layers button.

params.name: Debug: performance log
params.tooltip:
Off: normal play. On: every 30 s, Supply Gaps writes how
long its overlay ticks, window and area labels took to the
game's log file (stdout.txt, lines starting with [SQPERF]).
Only for tracking down slowdowns; leave it Off otherwise.
Slow calls are always logged briefly, whatever this setting.
